C60.content_en:
Ways to check a page's basic facts — and how the main tools compare

In web building and SEO work you first want to know what state the client's page is in right now. Enter one URL and this tool lays out the title, description, heading counts, word count, load time and the check flags DataForSEO attaches, in four tables.

* You can now enter many items, one per line (each is sent one by one, so you pay per item). The table gets an "Input" column. Where the text below says "one", it describes a single item. See the table at the top for the cost.

Method / toolPricing modelNotes
This tool (DataForSEO)Pay per request. About $0.00015 per call (measured), roughly 6,600 per $1One page's title, description, headings, word count, load time and check flags in tables. Save as CSV
Screaming Frog SEO SpiderThe free version covers up to 500 URLs; the paid licence is £199 per year (official pricing page)Desktop software that crawls a whole site
Google Search Console (URL inspection)FreeCovers sites whose ownership you have verified (see the official site for features)
Browser "view page source" (by hand)FreeYou read one page at a time; counting headings is manual work

Checked in November 2026. Prices change — confirm on each vendor's official site before you buy.

Why use this tool

  • One page becomes a table in seconds. We measured under a second.
  • Heading counts included. The blog article we tried (about 5,054 words) had one H1, 19 H2, 31 H3 and eight H4 (measured with shopify.com/blog/how-to-start-a-blog).
  • About $0.00015 per call. Roughly 6,600 per $1, so checking a client's pages one by one costs very little.
  • Load time is shown. That article loaded in 85 ms (DataForSEO's own measurement).
  • Save as CSV. Use the result as a draft for a quote or a report.

When it is not the right fit

  • You want to check a whole site at once → this tool does one page at a time. Crawler software fits better.
  • You want a speed score → "See a page's speed scores" fits better.
  • You want search rankings → the tables here do not show rankings.
  • Words such as "too long", "too short" and "slow" in the check flags are DataForSEO's own thresholds. See DataForSEO's documentation for the thresholds.

This tool does one thing: show one page's title, description, headings, word count, load time and check flags.

FAQ

How far do you count headings?

H1 through H6. For each level you get the count and the heading text.

What unit is the load time in?

Milliseconds (1,000 ms = 1 second). It is measured on DataForSEO's side, so it can differ from what you see on your own computer.

Does "Yes" in the check flags mean something is wrong?

No. It simply answers the sentence in the item name. If "No H1 tag" says Yes, no H1 was found.

Can it check pages behind a login?

We have not tried it. We tested public pages.

Can I sign up with a free email address?

No. DataForSEO does not accept free email providers. See What is DataForSEO?

C61.content_en:
Ways to pull a rival article's headings and text — and how the main tools compare

When you write a blog post, you want to know what headings the top articles use and what they say under each one. Enter an article URL and this tool tabulates the text under each heading (H1 to H4).

* You can now enter many items, one per line (each is sent one by one, so you pay per item). The table gets an "Input" column. Where the text below says "one", it describes a single item. See the table at the top for the cost.

Method / toolPricing modelNotes
This tool (DataForSEO)Pay per request. About $0.00015 per call (measured), roughly 6,600 per $1Heading level, heading and the text under it, one row each. Save as CSV
Read the article in a browser (by hand)FreeYou note the headings yourself; slow for long articles
Screaming Frog SEO SpiderThe free version covers up to 500 URLs; the paid licence is £199 per year (official pricing page)Crawler software; see the official site for how headings are extracted
Paste the text into an AI chat (by hand)Varies by service (see each official site)You have to collect and paste the text yourself

Checked in November 2026. Prices change — confirm on each vendor's official site before you buy.

Why use this tool

  • The skeleton of an article at a glance. The article we tried (shopify.com/blog/how-to-start-a-blog) came out as 42 headings with their text (measured).
  • Text sits next to its heading. Read what appears under a heading in one row.
  • About $0.00015 per call. Roughly 6,600 per $1, so you can check as many articles as you like.
  • A few seconds. The sample came back in under a second.
  • Save as CSV. Use it as groundwork when you plan your own headings.

When it is not the right fit

  • You want to copy the article as is → reusing someone else's writing raises copyright issues. Use this only to learn structure.
  • You need images or table contents → the table shows headings and text only.
  • You want word count or load time → "See a page's basic facts" fits better.
  • The split between main and other content is DataForSEO's own call, so the order can differ from top-to-bottom on the page.

This tool does one thing: pull an article's headings (H1 to H4) and the text under them.

FAQ

Why is the order not top to bottom?

DataForSEO returns the page split into main content and other content. This tool lists the main part first.

What happens with long text?

The sentences under a heading are joined into one cell. For long ones, save as CSV and read it in a spreadsheet.

May I use other people's articles?

Looking at them for research rarely causes trouble, but copying text and publishing it raises copyright issues. Ask a professional if you are unsure.

Does it work on any page?

We tried one blog article. Other pages may come back differently.

Can I sign up with a free email address?

No. DataForSEO does not accept free email providers. See What is DataForSEO?
